summary: Lami was a Nomai child who grew up on Brittle Hollow and Ember Twin. Sibling of Laevi and niece/nephew of Pye, Lami was the youngest Anglerfish-game player and the only one still small enough to fit through the Anglerfish Overlook hole.

behavior: Lami was a curious, mildly rule-breaking child.
location: Lami grew up on Brittle Hollow and Ember Twin.
Lami attended school in the Hanging City.
Lami moved to the Statue Workshop on Giant's Deep with Laevi and Taget during Ash Twin Project construction.
lore: Lami was the sibling of Laevi.
Lami was the niece/nephew of Pye.
Lami played the Anglerfish game in the Sunless City with Laevi, Taget, Ilex, and Solanum.
Lami was still small enough to climb through the hole at the Anglerfish Overlook.
Lami gave the Anglerfish fossil a new lantern using the hole-access route.
Lami opposed Laevi's blindfold rule, saying the game was too hard if you cannot see anything.
Lami wrote a school essay 'Explanation of Festivals' describing Nomai clans gathering to share science and art.
Lami proposed sneaking into Phlox's memory-statue test through the alternative entrance; Taget and Laevi refused.
Lami died when Ghost Matter from the Interloper killed all Nomai in the solar system.
